hypothesis: The exact frozen PROFILE=fidelity tuple reproduces its stored runtime envelope on AIBoss under the clean source-pinned runtime and a bounded rollback transaction.
falsifier: Any identity mismatch, non-regression metric failure, wrong INT6 embedding/profile flag, fatal runtime marker, missing route evidence, or failed owner-service restoration falsifies the recapture.

measurement_plan.purpose: identity and runtime-envelope recapture; fixed-N paired candidate blocks remain unopened

decision_rules.accept: Every frozen profile check passes, the served/container identities and INT6 profile match, logs contain no fatal/fallback marker, and rollback is proven.
decision_rules.reject: Any frozen profile, identity, runtime-integrity, or rollback condition fails.
decision_rules.abort: Abort on OOM, engine death, live-path mutation, competing GPU process, timeout, or failed restore.
